programs.description: Geetha's murder is pinned on Ramu, the man she rejected, while the real culprits, Johnny, Rahim, Swami and Kannan, get off scot-free. However, the four spoilt brats fail to elude their karma.
Sunil marries Varma's mentally disabled sister, then attempts to kill her, as police investigate his motives for these shocking actions.
Diwakaran, a thief, steals jewellery from Aravindakshan, a school teacher. Jayashankar, a police officer who in reality is Diwakaran's brother-in-law, is appointed to investigate the case.
Bringing the best in television.
Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.
Karthi and Riya, from two different religions, fall in love. Fearing their parents' disapproval of their inter-religious relationship, they elope to Ooty but return after a heated argument.
Gopinadhan and Mathunni steal money from the rich and distribute it amongst the needy. When Mathunni robs Maya, Gopinadhan returns it and falls in love with her.
Hyder Ali Hassan, a scheming politician, is in league with the underworld and runs a lot of illegal businesses. Balachandran, an IPS officer, is sent on a mission to capture him.

Sachi and his girlfriend, Vasudha, go on a date to celebrate her birthday. Things go sideways, and their love is tested when they are harassed by two men on a late-night drive.
Prabhavathy, one of five children, marries a rich businessman, Shekharankutty, and forgets about her family. Her husband decides to make her understand the importance of her family.
A devotee narrates the history of the Sabarimala Temple in addition to the miracles experienced by other devotees, to pilgrims assembled there.
Geetha's murder is pinned on Ramu, the man she rejected, while the real culprits, Johnny, Rahim, Swami and Kannan, get off scot-free. However, the four spoilt brats fail to elude their karma.
When Ravishankar, a journalist, learns that he has blood cancer, he gets depressed and loses all hope of living. However, his life changes for the better when he meets a friend, who is a doctor.
A man with average looks, lives an unconfident life and continuously suspects and spies on his attractive wife, until she resolves to leave him due to his nature.

After escaping his father's control, a man builds a new life only to be torn between loyalty and truth when his past and present dangerously collide.
Vava, a villager, goes through many troubles as he is born to a Christian mother and a Brahmin father. However, he is determined to prove to the society that love matters the most.
Kunjulakshmi, pampered by her brothers, is somewhat arrogant. When she falsely accuses Sivashankaran, a peon, of misbehaving with her, he decides to teach her a lesson.

Although married, Vishnu is a habitual flirt and always looks out for an affair. When he is almost caught with a young girl in his house, he lies to his family that she is his illegitimate daughter.
A corrupt police officer tries to get Varunan involved in terrorist activities for his own gain. When he refuses, he kills Varunan's father and puts the blame on him.
Balan, a barber, struggles to give his family a better living. However, his life changes when his old friend, who is a film star, comes to his village for a film shoot.
Jayarajan, the assistant manager at a tea estate, plans to steal money from his company with the help of two subordinates. However, things do not go as planned, which leaves them in a tough spot.
Two Hindu siblings happily live with each other. Problems occur when the sister falls in love with a Christian and the brother opposes it.

After many years, Dharman, a rich man, goes back to his village to take revenge against Thommichan, a businessman, for ruining his family.

In an attempt to marry his beloved Anjali, Gopi dedicates himself to finding suitable matches for her unmarried sisters. However, one fateful night changes their lives forever when he accidentally commits a crime.

When Alexander, a prominent leader, is falsely accused of murdering a CM, Danny, his nephew, navigates a web of political intrigue and danger to uncover the truth and prove Alexander's innocence.
